summary:
Project Lunatrix is an interactive, space-themed educational mobile and web game developed under the "Humans in Space Junior Astronaut Training Mission" category. Designed to inspire children and young learners, the app features an immersive dark-galaxy interface complete with a split-letter logo intro animation, planet exploration featuring all planets and their names (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto), star-collection mechanics, and rocket launch sequences.
​A key highlight of Lunatrix is its educational mini-games—such as the Oxygen Management System and an interactive Plant Growing System where students learn botany and life support in space by managing water, light, and nutrients to grow plants on extraterrestrial surfaces. These systems teach critical space survival and science concepts, including water collection, electrolysis, O_2 storage, air recycling, and life support systems. By blending engaging storytelling, gamified UI interactions, and hands-on space science, Lunatrix transforms complex space missions into an exciting and accessible learning adventure.
details:
Project Lunatrix is an interactive, space-themed educational mobile and web game developed under the "Humans in Space Junior Astronaut Training Mission" category. Designed to inspire children and young learners, the application features an immersive dark-galaxy interface complete with a split-letter logo intro animation, planet exploration featuring all planets and their names (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto), star-collection mechanics, and rocket launch sequences.

​The application incorporates engaging educational mini-games:

​Oxygen Management System: Teaches children critical space survival and life support concepts through a 7-step interactive process including checking oxygen levels, collecting water, performing electrolysis, storing O_2, supplying oxygen, air recycling, and completing missions.

​Plant Growing System: Teaches botany and life support in space by allowing students to manage water, light, and nutrients to grow plants on extraterrestrial surfaces.

​Tools, Coding Languages, and Software Used:

​Frontend & Prototyping: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Android Studio, Flutter, and AI prototyping tools to build responsive web and mobile interfaces.

​Design & Storytelling Elements: Custom dark-galaxy UI layouts, neon accent styling, SVG/CSS animations, and interactive step-by-step game logic flows.

​Benefits, Impact, and Creativity:

Lunatrix transforms complex space missions and astronaut survival science into an exciting, accessible, and gamified learning adventure. By blending storytelling, interactive UI elements, and hands-on space science, it fosters curiosity in young learners and introduces them to fundamental concepts in astronomy, environmental recycling, and life support systems.
